CREATE TABLE document.product ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, name_uz TEXT, name_ru TEXT, name_en TEXT, description TEXT, company_id UUID NOT NULL, mxic TEXT, package_code TEXT, product_unit TEXT, package_id UUID, price double precision, image TEXT, barcode TEXT, deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL, created_date TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP, version BIGINT DEFAULT 0 );
CREATE TABLE document.contract_product ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, document_id UUID NOT NULL, product_id UUID NOT NULL, amount double precision NOT NULL, price double precision NOT NULL, name_uz TEXT, name_ru TEXT, name_en TEXT, description TEXT, company_id UUID, mxic TEXT, package_code TEXT, product_unit TEXT, package_id UUID, image TEXT, barcode TEXT, deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL, created_date TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP, version BIGINT DEFAULT 0 );
